card.text: Explore Bebhionn, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Bebhionn’s two-peaked light curve constrains a minimum equatorial ratio of 1.41:1. This ellipsoid illustrates that elongation with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.41:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
